COT.definition: weekly change in managed money net longs / total open interest, percentage points, futures-only consistent CFTC gold series; clip(change_pp/5,-1,1)
COT.sign: positive hypothesis; crowded positioning may reverse
COT.release: actual public release before cutoff; not Tuesday observation date

OPTIONS_SKEW.definition: change over five completed sessions in constant 1-month GLD 25-delta call IV minus put IV, percentage points; clip(change_pp/3,-1,1)
OPTIONS_SKEW.sign: positive hypothesis; hedging demand and dealer positioning can confound
OPTIONS_SKEW.availability: NOT_VERIFIED; no approved raw options vendor yet

candidate.remaining_features: inherit exact M2 definitions; no renormalization; same formula and amplitude
